scope: A consolidated record of owner-reviewed outreach sends and the bounded read-only reply audit for the genuine external export, permission, rights, authority, and engagement blockers in the Phase 1 access-block matrix. Gmail Sent-label searches verified the exact sender, recipient, subject, and sent timestamp for the seven named messages; the separate reply audit records eight substantive replies and four acknowledgement-only records without retaining message IDs, thread IDs, body content, personal contact fields, attachments or mailbox links. The FOM form submission and clarification reply are recorded separately and do not supply permission or access. A send, form submission, reply, routing instruction or follow-up is not an acquisition, permission, archive, transformation, ingestion, owner source-ledger decision, production-admission decision or production eligibility.
